The challenge of cybersecurity in health is not theoretical, but real and immediate; the challenge is shared, but it is not insurmountable; and it requires both individual and collective actions.
cybersecurity is a foundational requirement for the ethical conduct of health research and for health services and policy in the 21st-century.

cybersecurity in health is an imperative, not a choice, that it is a collective responsibility, that the health sector is vulnerable and that there are opportunities for strengthening cybersecurity in health.
